description.en: Creates the "can talk" prompt icon shown above characters that can be interacted with on the map top layer (TL).
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Show the talk-prompt icon over interactable characters
CMND_CREATE_TALK_ICON_FOR_TL();
